title: ANALISTA PLANEJAMENTO COMERCIAL - CORPORATIVO - CASA PRADO
description:
É tempo de ser marcante!!

Somos uma marca especialista em moda masculina!

Propósito da marca : Elevar a autoestima das pessoas!

Estamos em busca de profissionais que não se contentam com um simples emprego, mas que enxergam no trabalho um constante desafio. Se você é uma pessoa movida pela paixão por encontrar soluções, inovar e alcançar resultados, essa é a oportunidade para você! Procuramos alguém com atitude imbatível, comprometimento e uma mentalidade voltada para o crescimento. Se você é determinado, busca sempre a excelência e tem o desejo de fazer a diferença no planejamento comercial, queremos conhecê-lo!

Você busca uma oportunidade, nós buscamos o seu talento!

Quais serão os seus desafios?

  • Analisar o desempenho de vendas da empresa, coletando e interpretando dados de vendas, identificando tendências e oportunidades de melhoria, para fornecer insights que subsidiem a tomada de decisões estratégicas de vendas.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o plano de vendas da empresa, definindo metas de vendas por produto, região e canal, monitorando o desempenho em relação às metas e propondo ajustes quando necessário, para garantir o alcance dos objetivos de vendas da empresa.
  • Realizar análises de mercado, estudando o comportamento dos consumidores, a concorrência e as tendências do mercado, para identificar oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolver estratégias de vendas eficazes.
  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de previsão de vendas, utilizando técnicas estatísticas e ferramentas de análise de dados, para prever a demanda futura e otimizar o planejamento de produção e estoque.
  • Monitorar e analisar os indicadores de desempenho de vendas (KPIs), como volume de vendas, margem de lucro, participação de mercado e taxa de conversão, para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e acompanhar o progresso em relação às metas.
  • Realizar análises de rentabilidade de produtos e clientes, identificando os produtos e clientes mais rentáveis e propondo ações para otimizar a rentabilidade da empresa.
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações gerenciais, consolidando dados de vendas, análises de mercado e previsões de vendas, para fornecer informações claras e concisas para a tomada de decisões da equipe de vendas e da alta gestão.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de marketing, produtos e finanças, fornecendo informações e análises que subsidiem o desenvolvimento de estratégias de marketing, o lançamento de novos produtos e o planejamento financeiro da empresa.
  • Acompanhar a performance das campanhas de vendas, analisando os resultados das campanhas, identificando os canais e ações mais eficazes e propondo ajustes para otimizar o retorno sobre o investimento.
  • Identificar e analisar oportunidades de expansão de mercado, avaliando o potencial de novos mercados, canais de vendas e parcerias estratégicas, para contribuir para o crescimento da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Ciência de dados, Estatística ou qualquer formação que seja compatível com as atribuições do cargo.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco;

  • Indique um Amigo;
  • Plataforma de terapia online;
  • Totalpass;
  • Day Off de aniversário.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
At Infobip, we dream big. We value creativity, persistence, and innovation, passionately believing that it is through teamwork that we can all reach greater heights.


Since 2006, we have been innovating at the edge of technological possibilities and are now shaping global communications of the future. Through 75+ offices on six continents, Infobip’s platform is used by almost 80% of the population, making it the largest network of its kind and the only full-stack cloud communication platform globally.

The engineer in this role participates in the activities for Infobip’s solution proposals, owns the solution design, delivery and integrations, improvement of the current solutions . To deliver the desired business results, Solution Engineers collaborate with the HQ and regional teams and act as technical opportunity leads or assist the more experienced colleagues . They independently manage opportunities from initiation to delivery.

Help customers and /or partners understand the value of Infobip solutions and services

Understand the customers’ businesses, knowing exactly which of our solutions and products can help them evolve their business

Design new and innovative solutions to meet customers ’ business needs

Collect the technical requirements and design technical solutions and service integration plans

Handle technical and security questionnaires

Conduct captivating demos and POCs

Conduct scoping exercises and provide service quote estimation

Implement solutions for new and existing customers

Configure/customize Infobip solutions to meet customer’s business requirements

Fluent/Advanced English is mandatory

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success Regional Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Product owner
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner altamente motivado e focado em resultados para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras de crédito com garantias. O candidato ideal será responsável por definir e priorizar o backlog de produtos, trabalhar diretamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e garantir que nossas soluções atendam às necessidades dos clientes e do negócio. Além disso, terá um papel fundamental na validação de hipóteses, utilizando testes e experimentos para tomar decisões baseadas em dados e aprimorar continuamente o produto.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo que as funcionalidades entreguem valor ao cliente e ao negócio.
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas internas (executivos, marketing, vendas, suporte ao cliente) para alinhamento da visão do produto e definição de prioridades.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir testes e experimentos para validar hipóteses de funcionalidades, utilizando abordagens como testes A/B, MVPs (Produto Mínimo Viável) e outras técnicas de validação.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio e de usuários em histórias claras e detalhadas para o time de desenvolvimento, com critérios de aceitação bem definidos.
  • Monitorar e analisar os resultados de testes para determinar o sucesso das hipóteses e ajustar o backlog com base em dados concretos e insights obtidos.

title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical
The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.
A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.
Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Analista fiscal de contabilidade
description:
O cargo de Analista Fiscal em uma empresa de contabilidade envolve a responsabilidade por atividades relacionadas à apuração e controle de tributos, com foco no cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e tributárias das empresas clientes. O analista fiscal desempenha um papel fundamental na gestão das obrigações fiscais, garantindo que os tributos sejam calculados corretamente e pagos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos pela legislação.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Apuração de Tributos: Calcular e controlar tributos como ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, entre outros, conforme a legislação vigente.
  2. Preenchimento de Obrigações Acessórias: Elaborar e transmitir as declarações fiscais, como DCTF, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DIRF, entre outras.
  3. Análise de Documentos Fiscais: Verificar a regularidade dos documentos fiscais recebidos (notas fiscais de entrada e saída), garantindo que os mesmos estejam de acordo com as exigências legais.
  4. Consultoria Fiscal: Prestar suporte e orientação aos clientes sobre questões fiscais, como o enquadramento tributário mais vantajoso, mudanças na legislação e procedimentos para regularização de pendências fiscais.
  5. Apuração de Impostos Diretos e Indiretos: Realizar a apuração de impostos sobre a produção e circulação de mercadorias e serviços, bem como impostos sobre a renda e contribuições.
  6. Controle de Créditos e Débitos Fiscais: Gerenciar os créditos tributários gerados pelas compras e serviços prestados e garantir que sejam utilizados corretamente para compensação de tributos devidos.
  7. Acompanhamento de Mudanças na Legislação Fiscal: Manter-se atualizado sobre as mudanças na legislação tributária e fiscal, implementando as alterações necessárias nos processos da empresa e repassando as informações para os clientes.
  8. Acompanhamento de Auditorias Fiscais: Auxiliar na preparação para auditorias fiscais, garantindo que toda a documentação e os registros estejam em conformidade.
  9. Regularização de Pendências Fiscais: Auxiliar na negociação de parcelamentos e regularização de pendências fiscais com o fisco.

Requisitos:

  1. Formação: Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  2. Conhecimentos: Domínio das obrigações fiscais e tributárias, sistemas de gestão contábil e fiscal, SPED, EFD, DCTF, entre outras ferramentas.
  3. Experiência: Experiência prévia em escritórios de contabilidade, departamentos fiscais ou em empresas de grande porte.
  4. Habilidades: Atenção aos detalhes, organização, capacidade analítica e habilidades de comunicação.

Esse cargo exige profissional com boa capacidade de análise, habilidades para lidar com a legislação tributária complexa e uma comunicação eficaz, além de ser um elo importante entre a empresa e o fisco.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

description:
Coordenadora/Coordenador de Integridade e Confiabilidade Filtragem - Vaga exclusiva para pessoas negras

Está em busca de um futuro emocionante? Então, nós temos uma excelente oportunidade.

Na Anglo American, acreditamos em resultados extraordinários. Isso significa que estamos sempre procurando novas e melhores maneiras de fazer as coisas, forjando um novo curso em nosso setor para maior eficiência, zero dano e maior sustentabilidade.

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com propósito, pois nosso objetivo é "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas", fornecendo metais e minerais que possibilitam a vida moderna, desde telefones a medicamentos.

Estamos transformando nossas operações questionando o pensamento existente e aplicando novas ideias e avanços tecnológicos para enfrentar os principais desafios da mineração. Inovamos com um objetivo: buscar novas maneiras de trabalhar que sejam mais seguras e responsáveis, focando na saúde e bem-estar de nossos colegas e das comunidades onde atuamos.

No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado em Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações em Barro Alto e Niquelândia, Goiás. Além disso, temos uma estrutura corporativa em Belo Horizonte.

Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Como Coordenador(a) de Integridade e Confiabilidade Filtragem , você será responsável por coordenar os processos de priorização, planejamento e execução das atividades de integridade estrutural da filtragem, realizados por equipe própria e terceirizada. Também garantirá a disponibilidade, integridade e desempenho dos ativos da planta, aplicando metodologias de confiabilidade (RCM, FMEA, análise de falhas) e estratégias de manutenção preditiva e preventiva. Atuará na identificação e mitigação de riscos operacionais, desenvolvendo planos de manutenção baseados na criticidade, liderando investigações de falhas, propondo melhorias técnicas e coordenando inspeções técnicas especializadas. Trabalhará de forma integrada com áreas de engenharia, operação e segurança, assegurando conformidade com normas técnicas, desempenho sustentável dos equipamentos e suporte à tomada de decisão com base em dados e indicadores de performance.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

  1. Coordenar a equipe de preditiva e planejamento, além da execução de atividades relacionadas à integridade estrutural.
  2. Elaborar e manter planos de integridade baseados na criticidade dos ativos e na segurança.
  3. Investigar falhas estruturais ou mecânicas, conduzindo análises de falha e elaboração de planos de ação corretivos.
  4. Definir e revisar estratégias de manutenção baseada em condição (CBM), utilizando vibração, ultrassom, termografia, entre outros.
  5. Avaliar a criticidade estrutural dos ativos e priorizar intervenções conforme matriz de risco.
  6. Aplicar ferramentas como RCM (Reliability Centered Maintenance) e FMEA para melhorar a disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos.
  7. Acompanhar KPIs como MTBF, MTTR, disponibilidade estrutural, backlog de manutenção, número de inspeções realizadas versus planejadas, etc.
  8. Capacitar a equipe de manutenção e operação em práticas seguras e eficazes para garantir a integridade dos ativos.
  9. Manter atualizados desenhos, laudos de inspeção, relatórios de integridade, certificados e históricos de manutenção.
  10. Atuar proativamente junto à operação para reportar anomalias e mitigar riscos à segurança e continuidade operacional.
  11. Colaborar na elaboração e controle do orçamento de manutenção e inspeção de ativos estruturais e de confiabilidade.
  12. Implementar melhorias contínuas nos processos de manutenção e operação.
  13. Coordenar a equipe, realizando controle de ponto, reuniões de feedback, análises de promoções e movimentações salariais, entre outras atividades de gestão.
  14. Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança, Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial da Anglo American.

O perfil que buscamos:

  • Ensino Superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção ou Automação.
  • Desejável Mestrado em Engenharia de Manutenção, Pós-graduação em Engenharia de Manutenção ou Estruturas.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time?

Somos uma empresa comprometida em transformar nossas crenças e valores em ações concretas. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho de qualidade, diverso e seguro, onde você pode desenvolver seu potencial. Conheça nossos benefícios:

  • Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental: Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (para você e dependentes), Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional.
  • Para sua família: Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação.
  • Espaço para ser você mesmo: participação em Grupos de Afinidades e eventos da Semana da Diversidade.
  • Plano de Previdência Privada, transporte fretado, refeições no local, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, apoio jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.

Compromisso com sua segurança:

Priorizamos sua segurança, investindo em tecnologias e seguindo rigorosos padrões de segurança para garantir que você volte para casa em segurança após o trabalho.

Inclusão e Diversidade:

Valorizamos e respeitamos todas as identidades e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, com Grupos de Afinidades para discutir e promover ações de diversidade e inclusão.

Queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e confiantes para trazer seu verdadeiro eu ao trabalho.

title: Delivery Leader (Brazil) LAC
description:
Delivery Associates (DA) is a global consultancy helping the public sector deliver lasting impact through effective implementation. With roots in Deliverology and over a decade of experience, we support leaders from strategy to execution. Our remote team works worldwide with governments and philanthropies to scale results.

We’re committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion—believing empowered, diverse teams drive stronger partnerships and more equitable outcomes.

Description

Location: Recife, Brazil (candidates should be based or be willing to reallocate to Recife for the rest of 2025).

Delivery Associates work with leaders in the public sector and impact organizations to solve problems, build consensus and implement policies and programs that impact millions of people. We use a clear methodology to solve problems and help our partners deliver results. We’re successful in part because we master our approach and in part because we are empathetic, resourceful, level-headed, and dedicated to our clients and the people they serve

As a Delivery Leader, you’ll work with our partners (in government, in philanthropy, and at multilateral and nonprofit organizations). You are comfortable building and leading direct client relationships, drafting materials based on client need and feedback from other DA team members, and being both proactive and reactive within a typical professional services client project context.

Skill Sets.

We work closely in diverse, global teams, leaning on each other’s strengths. We don’t expect any one person to do all these things perfectly. Our Delivery Leaders should be able to:

● Ability to build capacity on data use for decision making: Support government partners to improve their data capacities and practices effectively.

● Build and lead relationships: Earn trust and influence among diverse stakeholders, especially in the public sector, philanthropy, or nonprofit world.

● Facilitate and coach: Run effective meetings and workshops that drive towards problem solving and consensus.

● Model and analyze data: Turn raw data into actionable insights and recommendations, whether through Excel or other platforms.

● Write and present clearly: Turn complex problems or insights into clear documents and well-structured slides; speak clearly and concisely in remote and in-person settings.

● Prioritize and manage projects: Bring clear structure and planning to day-to-day work and communication.

● Solve problems: Break down problems and identify root causes before developing hypotheses and solutions.

● Stay focused: Navigate complexity, especially in policy and program implementation, consistently steering large coalitions back to a single-minded focus on priority outcomes.

Mindsets.

We work well with people who are:

● Adaptable: Public sector work is dynamic. Our people are, too.

● Analytical: We identify, dissect, and solve complex problems, following the data and evidence.

● Accountable: We are a remote team. We work collaboratively but self-sufficiently; oversight is often minimal, while proactivity is essential.

● Driven: Our work is important, so it’s important we do it well.

● Collaborative: We are flexible, thoughtful and team players.

● Curious: We never stop learning from our clients, colleagues, and partners.

● Inclusive: We embrace all voices and backgrounds; it enriches our work.

Profile.

Many of our people have backgrounds in government, philanthropy, think tanks, policy research, and non-profits. Some come from startups and tech. Our Delivery Leaders generally have already 5-8 years in other organizations and often have experience with our major verticals: climate, education, health, government innovation. But we’ve done this long enough to know that what matters most is your skill set and your mindset. We are open to lots of backgrounds as long as you can show us you’re an analytical thinker, a clear communicator, a team player, and an avid learner.

Required Experience.

These are the basics.

● Bachelor’s degree or equivalent requisite experiences; Masters degree is a plus.

● A minimum of 5-8 years of relevant, full time work experience in government, consulting, public policy, project management and/or impact measurement

● Business level proficiency in English; Spanish proficiency is highly desirable.

● Expertise in data analysis and facilitation of trainings and workshops to enhance data capacity in governments.

● Experience working in the standard business suite (analyzing data in spreadsheets, creating presentations, etc)

● Based in Recife for the remaining of 2025; after that, based in Brazil with willingness to travel up to 25-40% and be accessible to an airport.

● Must be based in and have work authorization to work in Brazil. Delivery Associates will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

This role focuses on enabling and supporting CI/CD, deployment automation, and operational stability for Azure-based data and analytics platforms. It includes deploying and managing pipelines, enforcing security practices, and collaborating closely with data engineering and QA teams.

  • Partner with QA and engineering to support test environments and rollout readiness.

  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Nice to Have
  • Azure CLI, PowerShell for on-demand resource management
  • Purview integration for lineage and data classification
  • Voltage SecureData or similar tokenization/masking frameworks
  • Scalable secrets management strategies
  • Cost visibility tools:

title: Gerente Comercial Anápolis - GO Legal person
description:
No Grupo Ramasa, valorizamos o comprometimento com a excelência. Se você é um profissional com brilho nos olhos e apaixonado pelo que faz, acreditamos que, com sua experiência e paixão, você não só contribuirá para o nosso sucesso contínuo, mas também se tornará uma peça fundamental no crescimento e na evolução da nossa organização. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  • Supervisionar, treinar e motivar a equipe, estabelecendo metas claras e acompanhando seu desempenho.
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe para discutir estratégias, metas e resultados.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas alinhadas com os objetivos da concessionária e da montadora.
  • Analisar o mercado, a concorrência e as tendências do setor para identificar oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Garantir um alto nível de satisfação dos clientes, promovendo um atendimento de qualidade e personalizado.
  • Resolver problemas e reclamações de clientes de maneira eficiente e satisfatória.
  • Promover a fidelização de clientes através de programas de relacionamento e follow-up pós-venda.
  • Utilizar ferramentas e sistemas para monitorar e analisar os dados de vendas.
  • Identificar áreas de melhoria e propor ações corretivas quando necessário.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de marketing para desenvolver campanhas promocionais e eventos de vendas.
  • Participar ativamente na promoção da marca e dos produtos da concessionária.
  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência em cargos de gestão de vendas, preferencialmente no setor automotivo.

Fundado em 1976, o Grupo Ramasa tem sua história edificada por relacionamentos duradouros, norteado pela consolidação de marcas comprometidas com a geração sustentável de valor.

O Grupo se ramifica por diversos estados do Brasil: Goiás, Distrito Federal, Mato Grosso, Tocantins, Pará, Pernambuco e Alagoas, com atuação nos segmentos da construção civil, hotelaria, logística (armazenagem, aduana e gestão dos modais ferroviário, rodoviário e aeroviário), agronegócio e automotivo.

A incursão no segmento automotivo teve início no ano de 1992, com a Lince, concessionária Toyota pioneira em Goiás. A marca Nissan se juntou ao Grupo no ano de 2010, com a abertura das concessionárias Katana. O ano de 2017 foi marcado pelo reforço das inglesas Jaguar e Land Rover, que se integrarem ao Grupo Ramasa, com a Silver Motors. E, mais recentemente, 2023, o Grupo trouxe aos seus negócios a marca inglesa de motocicletas Triumph, com a Silver Motocicletas.

No mesmo ano, a holding Ramasa inaugurou a divisão Ramasa Auto, um novo braço de negócios dedicado exclusivamente à expansão dos empreendimentos e iniciativas do segmento automotivo.

A Ramasa Auto é movida pela tradição e inovação do DNA Toyota, pela ousadia confiável da marca Nissan, com o reforço de originalidade e luxo das inglesas Jaguar, Land Rover e Triumph. A qualidade, dínamo de excelência, no motiva.

Ao longo desse meio século de existência, o cuidado com os clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores, meio ambiente, sociedade e acionistas garantiu a perenidade do Grupo Ramasa, uma das empresas mais sólidas e respeitadas de Goiás.

Nutrimos o objetivo de perene fomento a negócios confiáveis, lucrativos e duradouros para todos os nossos clientes e parceiros comerciais, buscando impactar cada vez mais positivamente as diversas cidades onde atuamos.

Neste trilhar, cumprimos nosso propósito de construir um legado de pioneirismo, responsabilidade e crescimento sustentável que honre o caminho já percorrido até aqui, inspirando as próximas gerações.

  • Experiência com análise de dados, modelagem estatística e construção de dashboards.

Diferenciais:

  7. Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  8. Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role summary

The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.

*Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil

KEY Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, including code quality, testing, and documentation.

Responsibilities and authorities

  • Authority to make technical decisions related to software architecture and design.
  • Access to all necessary information and tools to perform role effectively.
  • Responsibility for delivering high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.
  • Authority to mentor and provide career development support to junior developers.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project assignments and career development.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers

  • Internal: Work closely with other software developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.
  • External: Interact with external stakeholders during product demos or user feedback sessions.

Key competencies, Relevant Knowledge, skills and competEncies

  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Familiarity with Git versioning systems.

Languages

  • Proficiency in English for listening, reading and writing. Intermediate speaking skills in English. Proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese.

Computer skills

  • Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Java/Kotlin.
  • Deep knowledge of Spring MVC and/or Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in interacting with relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of distributed architectures and messaging systems (RabbitMQ, AMQP, etc).
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes, etc).

Experience

  • Software Engineer, Backend Engineer or similar position.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience.

Personal qualities

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead projects.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.

Expected outcome and deliverables -(For the role, on a 3-5 years horizon)

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.

Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

CONTRACT DETAILS

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.

  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

title: Senior Technical Designer in Animation
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Technical Designer in Animation (TDiA) to join our team working on Fortnite. As a TDiA, you will use your animation sense and technical understanding of character animation to design and create gameplay animation systems that facilitate appealing, high-quality character motion. You will be a primary point of contact for animation implementation issues and any animation-related technical challenges and will work closely with Animation, Design, and Programming colleagues to ensure the animation pipeline operates smoothly and efficiently. You will also help identify potential issues and deploy correct solutions, using your technical knowledge to help bridge and facilitate communication between the animation team and other departments.

In this role, you will

  • Help create animation behavior tools/techniques/philosophies that allow the building of complex movement systems
  • Design and implement animation state machines/behaviors and runtime solutions
  • Work closely with the Animation, Design, and Programming departments to analyze, troubleshoot, and solve in-game animation implementation issues and animation-related technical challenges
  • Closely collaborate with the animation leadership to maintain the style and quality bar for animations in the game
  • Look for opportunities to improve the animation pipeline/workflow and help provide solutions for technical animation problems, including performing training and creating documentation for the animation team

What we're looking for

  • Strong verbal communication skills, as well as both experience with and interest in team management and mentoring
  • A strong animation sense with a clear understanding of realistic and stylized character motion and how to achieve them with modern animation methods
  • Expertise with animation pipelines, including source content creation tools such as Maya, MotionBuilder, and the Unreal Engine using our Control Rig toolset
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Familiarity with gameplay animation tools and concepts, such as blend trees and state machines; experience with Unreal Engine Animation Blueprints is a plus
  • Experience with AAA game development, preferably on a large team using an established game engine (internal or commercial); experience with Unreal Engine is a plus
  • Self-motivation, a strong work ethic, and the ability to work independently

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

  8. Experiência em forecast de vendas e gestão de pipeline de negócios complexos

  7. Participação em eventos do setor representando a empresa

title: Engineering Technical Leader- Electrical Component
description:
Engineering Technical Leader- Electrical Component

Apply locations: Contagem, Brazil | Time type: Full time | Posted on: Posted 3 Days Ago | Job requisition id: R0097609

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

Essa posição é para atuar rem regime presencial, em Contagem, MG.

Who will you be working with?

Our best-in-class Electric Rotating Machines Engineering team develops a wide variety of products for rail, off-highway and drill applications. In this role, the Technical Leader will work with cross-functional teams to design and develop electric machines, as well as maintain and expand existing products.

How will you make a difference?

As a member of the Electric Rotating Machines team, you will be responsible for design, testing, application studies, field support, manufacturing support, and innovation on various machine topologies. You will support initiatives including hybrid and battery electric vehicles.

You will be responsible for motors and/or alternator electrical design, working with cross-functional teams to meet objectives. You will provide technical leadership on complex assignments with long-term business implications, manage complex issues within your expertise, and contribute to the overall business strategy.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field.
  • Strong experience with hardware design (motors, transformers, etc.).
  • Experience with rotating equipment (alternators, generators, AC/DC motors).
  • Good understanding of electromagnetics.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Fluent in English.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Provide technical leadership for Propulsion Engineering team.
  • Lead new product introduction, reliability, productivity, manufacturing, and sourcing projects.
  • Support management decisions, lead business case discussions for product planning.
  • Ensure technical quality, timely work completion, and responsiveness to customer needs.
  • Facilitate communication on technical and business issues.
  • Promote professional growth through feedback, coaching, and mentoring.
  • Ensure compliance with company initiatives and training.

Benefits:

At Wabtec, people are our priority. We offer a range of benefits to promote your well-being and development, including medical and dental assistance, profit sharing, private pension, meal policies, transportation benefits, life insurance, employee assistance programs, mental health apps, holiday gifts, extended maternity leave, programs for pregnant employees, language incentives, mentoring, and training platforms.

Who are we?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and services for freight, transit rail, mining, marine, and industrial markets. With nearly four centuries of collective experience, we are committed to innovation, performance, and creating sustainable transportation solutions worldwide.

Our Commitment to Diversity:

We embrace diversity and inclusion, valuing different backgrounds and perspectives that strengthen our company. We are committed to equal employment opportunities and accommodating employees with disabilities or special needs.

About Us

Wabtec is dedicated to realizing potential—both in transportation and in our people. We offer global opportunities to shape the future of transportation and support our employees’ growth. Join us and be part of a company that moves the world forward.

Artificial Intelligence Delivery Consultant, Professional Services

Are you looking to work at the forefront of Machine Learning and AI? Would you be excited to apply cutting edge Generative AI algorithms to solve real world problems with significant impact?

Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been strategic to Amazon from the early years. We are pioneers in areas such as recommendation engines, product search, eCommerce fraud detection, and large-scale optimization of fulfillment center operations.

In this role, you are a passionate, talented, and inventive AI specialist with a strong background in ML and AI, pushing the boundaries in Generative AI, Time Series, Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Computer Vision, Customer Segmentation, Fraud Prevention, Capacity Planning, Predictive Maintenance, and more. We’re looking for talented scientists who can leverage ML, Generative AI, and other techniques to design, implement, fine-tune, and evangelize state-of-the-art solutions for never-before-solved problems.

Key Job Responsibilities

  1. Design and develop robust and scalable AI solutions for business problems.
  2. Effectively use Foundation Models available on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker to meet our customer's performance needs.
  3. Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of historical data to help automate and optimize key processes.
  4. Strong communication skills, with attention to detail and ability to convey rigorous mathematical concepts and considerations to non-experts.
  5. Comfortable working in a fast paced, highly collaborative, dynamic work environment.

About the Team

The AI Delivery Team at Professional Services helps AWS customers accelerate the use of AI to solve business and operational challenges and promote innovation in their organization. The team helps customers imagine and scope the use cases that will create the greatest value for their businesses, select, train, and fine-tune the right models, define strategies to overcome technical or business challenges, build proof-of-concepts, and manage the scalable machine learning lifecycle to deliver robust, production-ready solutions.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent with 5+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent with 3+ years of experience.
  2. Experiences related to machine learning, deep learning, NLP, CV, GNN, or distributed training.
  3. 2+ years of relevant experience in developing and deploying large scale machine learning or deep learning models and/or systems into production, including batch and real-time data processing.
  4. Able to communicate effectively in English and Portuguese within technical and business settings.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Ph.D. degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, operations research, or in a highly quantitative field.
  2. Experiences related to AWS services such as SageMaker, EMR, S3, DynamoDB and EC2.
  3. Working knowledge of generative AI and hands-on experience in prompt engineering, deploying and hosting Large Foundational Models.
  4. Spanish B2+ is a plus.
